name: everruns
description: Official Everruns plugins for coding agents.

plugins.name: everruns
plugins.description: Use Everruns from your coding agent: build agents into Rust applications with the Framework, install Everruns on your own machines, hand tasks to your agents, build and test new ones, debug and evaluate them, ship them to Slack, the web and other channels, and keep an eye on cost and health.

plugins.name: styk
plugins.description: Connect your agent to Styk: coordinate thread tasks, share versioned files, review exact results, and follow rooms with independent consumers, push streams or webhooks.

plugins.name: stend
plugins.description: Publish a web page your agent built (a report, a dashboard, a one-pager) at a secret URL you share. Public or behind a password, revised in place, taken down when you say.
